metadata.title: The Seamstress's Revenge
metadata.subtitle: A diva influencer ripped my couture gown and demanded $200K—until my holding group canceled her entire Fashion Week deal.

nodes.text: 6:30 PM · Backstage at Milan-Paris Couture Gala. Working incognito in your late mother’s atelier as a seamstress, you adjust Scarlett’s hem—when she deliberately snags her diamond ring and rips the silk!
OH MY GOD!! This clumsy seamstress just destroyed my $200,000 finale gown ten minutes before the runway! Pay up or I’ll ruin your life!
You hooked your own ring into the hem, Scarlett. And I stitched that silk by hand—I know a deliberate tear when I see one.
Shut up! Nobody believes a nobody over a 10-million-follower icon! Kneel and apologize on my livestream right now!
Perfect drama for my vlog—and Maison Lumière’s sponsor will pay me double for the "wardrobe crisis"!

nodes.prompt: Scarlett shoves her phone camera into your face:

options.label: Refuse to kneel & check the fitting mirror
options.player_reply_text: Check the fitting-room ceiling before you livestream a lie, Scarlett.

options.label: Text VP Celine to suspend Lumière’s sponsor

nodes.text: You stay standing tall. Scarlett’s stylist Marco nervously glances up at the backstage security dome.
Security! Drag this arrogant seamstress off the venue before Lumière’s heiress arrives!
You tap one encrypted command to VP Celine. Scarlett’s agent’s phone immediately starts ringing off the hook.
Understood, Heiress {{player_name}}. Freezing Scarlett’s $3M Lumière endorsement right now.
As Scarlett smirks for her followers, her stylist Marco secretly slips a folded note into your pocket.
Psst... I recorded her bragging about ripping the gown on purpose. She hasn’t paid me in four months. Help me expose her!

nodes.headline: The Stylist’s Tape
nodes.teaser_text: Scarlett thinks she’s about to walk the Lumière runway as queen—unaware her own stylist just handed the true heiress the sabotage proof.

nodes.text: 6:42 PM · Inside the VIP green room, VP Celine calls while Marco forwards the backstage security clip.
Celine reports: "Heiress {{player_name}}, Scarlett’s team also billed Lumière $200K for a ‘replacement gown’ she bought for $400!"
Alert flashes: "Scarlett’s agency submitted a fraudulent $200K insurance claim to Lumière!"
Insurance fraud on top of ruining my mother’s archival silk? She picked the wrong seamstress.

nodes.caption: Backstage CCTV: Scarlett and her agent exchanging the fake $200K damage claim envelope.

nodes.prompt: Five minutes to the finale walk—how do you rescue the show?

options.label: Re-drape the torn silk in 3 minutes flat
options.player_reply_text: Hand me the gold pins, Marco. Watch how real couture handles a tear.

options.label: Walk the runway yourself as Lumière’s heiress

nodes.text: Your needles fly like lightning—transforming the jagged rip into a breathtaking asymmetric slit lined with golden thread.
Oh my god... that’s pure museum-grade genius! You’re NOT just a seamstress!!
You slip into your mother’s archival masterpiece, pinning the emerald brooch worn only by the Lumière Chairwoman.
Stunning, {{player_name}}! The runway lights are yours on my cue!
Out on the runway, Scarlett steps onto the catwalk in a cheap knockoff, bragging to the front row that the seamstress is fired.
Thank you, everyone! And don’t worry—Maison Lumière’s owner personally promised to ban that clumsy seamstress forever!

nodes.headline: The Runway Curtain Drops
nodes.teaser_text: Scarlett lies to 1,000 fashion editors that Lumière’s owner backed her—right as the giant screen behind her lights up.

nodes.text: 6:55 PM · The music cuts abruptly. Behind Scarlett, the 40-foot runway LED plays Marco’s HD video of her ripping the silk on purpose!
WAIT—TURN THAT OFF!! That’s edited!! Who touched the AV booth?!
I did, Scarlett. And for the record, I never promised to ban myself.

nodes.transcript: [over arena PA] "Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome the sole owner of Maison Lumière Holding Group—{{player_name}}!"

nodes.text: The seamstress IS the Lumière Heiress?! My career is over!!

nodes.prompt: You glide down the runway in the restored golden-slit gown:

options.label: Announce Scarlett’s $3M contract termination
options.player_reply_text: Effective immediately, Scarlett is terminated from Maison Lumière for fraud.

options.label: Call Marco onstage as new Head Stylist

nodes.text: A thousand cameras flash in unison as fashion editors rise to their feet applauding.
No!! Please {{player_name}}, I’ll pay back the gown—don’t cancel my Fashion Week deal!
You beckon Marco onto the spotlight, handing him the golden Lumière atelier badge as the crowd cheers.
I’m shaking!! Thank you, {{player_name}}—I’ll give my heart to this atelier!
Scarlett stumbles off the runway in tears—while her panicked agent rushes toward the backstage exit clutching a briefcase.
Wait—Scarlett’s agent just tried to wire the $200K fake claim out of our escrow! Security caught him at the door!

nodes.headline: The Agent’s Briefcase
nodes.teaser_text: Inside the agent’s briefcase sits proof that Scarlett didn’t just fake a torn dress—she stole your mother’s unreleased sketches.

nodes.text: 7:15 PM · Backstage Security Office. Celine spreads twenty hand-drawn sketches across the table—your late mother’s unreleased Autumn collection.
Those are my mother’s original sketches from the locked vault! Scarlett, you staged the ripped dress as a distraction to raid our atelier!
My agent forced me to do it! A rival brand offered us $1 million for Lumière’s Autumn line!

nodes.caption: Signed illicit buyout contract between Scarlett’s agency and rival house Velvet Noir.

nodes.text: If Velvet Noir’s CEO hears I confessed, I’m blacklisted from fashion forever...

nodes.prompt: Police arrive backstage to take Scarlett’s statement:

options.label: Press full charges on Scarlett & Velvet Noir
options.player_reply_text: Lock up everyone who touched my mother’s work.

options.label: Offer Scarlett reduced charges to flip on Velvet

nodes.text: Officers cuff both Scarlett and her agent as the rival brand’s contract is bagged as felony evidence.
Fashion Council just suspended Velvet Noir’s runway slot for tomorrow!
Terrified of prison, Scarlett hands over every encrypted chat with Velvet Noir’s CEO—blowing their whole espionage ring wide open!
Boom! Police just raided Velvet Noir’s headquarters with Scarlett’s chat logs!
You gently slide your mother’s twenty sketches back into the velvet portfolio—not a single page lost.
Velvet Noir’s prime closing slot tomorrow night is now empty... {{player_name}}, should we debut your mother’s Autumn collection?!

nodes.headline: 24 Hours To Couture
nodes.teaser_text: Can you and your atelier stitch your mother’s legendary collection overnight to claim the Fashion Week crown?

nodes.text: 2:00 AM · Lumière Atelier. Twenty seamstresses work side-by-side with you under warm lamps, cutting emerald silk and hand-beading lace.
Gown #14 is pressed and steamed! Nobody in Paris has ever seen an owner sew right beside her staff at 2 AM!
My mother built Maison Lumière with a needle and thread, Marco. This is where the magic actually lives.

nodes.transcript: [excited whisper] "Vogue, Harper’s, and every luxury buyer just confirmed front row for tomorrow’s surprise Lumière finale!"

nodes.text: Every brand dropped me tonight... my 10 million followers are unfollowing in waves...

nodes.prompt: Dawn breaks as the final stitch locks into place:

options.label: Put every seamstress’s name in the credits
options.player_reply_text: Tonight, every artisan in this room takes the runway bow with me.

options.label: Give the atelier team 10% of collection sales

nodes.text: Tears of pride fill the seamstresses’ eyes—for the first time, the hidden hands behind couture will be celebrated.
Best house in fashion history! Let’s make tonight unforgettable!
Celine drafts the profit-sharing deed on the spot—doubling every seamstress’s annual income overnight!
Signed and sealed! Morale in this atelier is through the roof!
Sunlight gleams off twenty breathtaking gowns lined along the golden racks.
Twelve hours to showtime, {{player_name}}. Ready to take the Fashion Week crown?

nodes.headline: Showtime Approaches
nodes.teaser_text: Tonight the fashion world witnesses the rebirth of Maison Lumière—and the final nail in Velvet Noir’s coffin.

nodes.text: 8:00 PM · Grand Palais Runway. Violins swell as the twenty emerald-and-gold gowns glide down the mirror catwalk.
{{player_name}}, buyers already pre-ordered $18 MILLION in five minutes! Velvet Noir just filed for bankruptcy!
Queue the finale lights, Marco. Bring every single seamstress out behind me.

nodes.transcript: [over roaring applause] "Look at the crowd—every single editor is on their feet cheering!"

nodes.text: Your mother would be so proud tonight.

nodes.prompt: You reach the edge of the runway under falling golden petals:

options.label: Hold up your seamstress thimble & bow
options.player_reply_text: Never underestimate the person holding the needle.

options.label: Dedicate the collection to your mother live

nodes.text: The tiny silver thimble catches the spotlight—instantly becoming the most iconic photo of Fashion Week.
Front page of Vogue tomorrow! Guaranteed!!
You touch the emerald brooch over your heart as the arena screen displays your mother’s portrait in warm gold.
Not a dry eye in the house, {{player_name}}. Pure perfection.
Backstage, champagne corks pop as your atelier celebrates the greatest triumph in Lumière’s history.
One last toast at the after-party—to the Seamstress Queen!

nodes.headline: The After-Party Crown
nodes.teaser_text: From being ordered to kneel to ruling Fashion Week—one final midnight toast closes the show.

nodes.text: 11:00 PM · Maison Lumière Terrace. The Eiffel skyline shimmers as your team toasts under crystal lanterns.
Heard Scarlett’s trial date was set—and she had to sell her handbags just to pay bail!
Let her learn what honest work feels like. Meanwhile, we have a Paris flagship to open.

nodes.transcript: [smiling warmly] "To the heiress who proved real luxury is stitched with heart, not arrogance!"

nodes.text: Still pinching myself—I’m Head Stylist at Maison Lumière!

nodes.prompt: How do you sign off Fashion Week?

options.label: Toast to the artisans of Lumière
options.player_reply_text: To every quiet pair of hands that makes the world beautiful!

options.label: Launch a free couture school for young tailors

nodes.text: Champagne glasses chime in harmony beneath the midnight stars.
Long live Maison Lumière!
You pledge $5M to open the Lumière Crafts Academy—giving young seamstresses worldwide a fair shot at the runway.
You just changed the whole industry, {{player_name}}!
Golden thread gleams on your sleeve as the spotlight of the fashion world shines firmly on you.
See you next season—front row.

nodes.headline: Act 2 · The Stolen Crest
nodes.teaser_text: Before the champagne cools, Celine gets an urgent customs alert—a counterfeit Maison Lumière flagship just opened in Milan using your mother’s trademarked crest!

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · Lumière Legal Suite. Morning light cuts through the blinds as Celine slides an urgent customs dossier across your desk.
Someone filed an international trademark transfer for Maison Lumière—dated three days BEFORE your mother passed away.

nodes.caption: Forged Intellectual Property Deed transferring the Lumière Gold Crest to Velvet Noir Holdings.

nodes.text: My mother couldn’t even lift a fountain pen that week. Whoever signed this had access to her private wax seal inside our own building.
You think winning one runway makes you queen? Wait until Milan strips your mother’s name off your doors tonight.

nodes.prompt: Velvet Noir’s lawyers demand you shut down your Paris flagship by noon:

options.label: File an emergency injunction at court
options.player_reply_text: Freeze their Milan registration immediately. I want every notary signature audited.

options.label: Send Marco undercover to Milan vault
options.player_reply_text: Marco knows Velvet Noir’s security blind spots. Put him on the first express train to Milan.

nodes.text: Filed! The court granted a 48-hour freeze—just enough time to unmask the mole inside Lumière.
Already boarding with my press pass! I’ll photograph whoever opens their VIP archive tonight.
Before the ink dries on your counter-order, your phone screen flashes with an encrypted Milan location ping.
Boss, you won’t believe whose private jet just landed at Milan Linate—it’s registered to a Lumière board member.

nodes.headline: The Boardroom Traitor
nodes.teaser_text: Scarlett was only the decoy—a senior Lumière insider just flew to Milan to hand over your mother’s legacy.

nodes.text: 11:48 PM · Paris Atelier Penthouse. Rain streaks the tall windows when Marco’s encrypted line rings urgently.
[whispering] I’m on the fire escape across from Velvet Noir’s vault! Two figures just unlocked the side door with a Lumière executive pass!

nodes.transcript: [urgent voicemail] Pick up! I caught two shadows unlocking Velvet Noir’s Milan vault with a Lumière master badge—sending the frame now!

nodes.caption: Milan alley security grab: Two silhouettes carrying archival Lumière dress tubes into Velvet Noir’s vault.

nodes.text: Look at the taller silhouette’s limp—and the gold cufflink! That’s the exact posture of the proxy who audited our Paris warehouse last week!

nodes.prompt: Guard flashlights sweep toward Marco’s fire escape:

options.label: Order Marco to retreat with the photo
options.player_reply_text: Get down safely, Marco! That photo is already worth more than their whole showroom.

options.label: Trigger Velvet Noir’s street fire alarm
options.player_reply_text: Marco, pull the street alarm box and snap their license plate while the guards scatter!

nodes.text: I’m clear and in a cab! Wait—they dropped a shipping manifest on the curb as I ran past!
Genius! Guards bolted out front—I got the license plate AND overheard them mention tomorrow’s Paris dye-house shipment!
A sudden chill hits the room as Celine cross-checks the shipping code against your morning Paris couture delivery.
{{player_name}}, they aren’t just stealing the trademark—they’re planning to sabotage our client gowns before tomorrow’s press gala!

nodes.headline: Poisoned Silk
nodes.teaser_text: Before dawn breaks, Scarlett’s hidden syndicate launches a ruthless smear campaign aimed straight at your flagship buyers.

nodes.text: 10:15 AM · Breaking Fashion News. Every phone in the Lumière showroom erupts with a viral headline accusing your emerald silk of toxic dye.
Aww, poor little seamstress! Ten VIP buyers just posted red rashes online—customs is seizing your entire autumn shipment as we speak!
Our atelier uses 100% organic botanical silk certified by Swiss labs. Nice try fabricating a health scare, Scarlett.

nodes.transcript: [smug laugh, background glass clinking] "Tell the broker our decoy dress worked like magic—by tonight Lumière’s stock hits zero!"

nodes.text: Wait—she sent that voice note to the wrong thread and deleted it two seconds too late! Our server auto-archived the audio!

nodes.prompt: Reporters swarm Lumière’s front gates demanding a statement:

options.label: Invite press inside to test raw silk live
options.player_reply_text: Open the gates. Let independent chemists swab any bolt of silk on our shelves live on camera.

options.label: Lock dye-house logs & pull 2 AM access
options.player_reply_text: Don’t just defend—pull the electronic door logs for our dye-house from 1 AM to 4 AM last night.

nodes.text: Bold move! Every live test came back 0.0% toxic—now the press is asking where that ONE rash-causing dress really came from!
Bingo! Someone swiped into the chemical storage room at 2:14 AM using an unregistered hotel-style VIP override card!
The live broadcast turns the tide—yet one chilling question remains: who physically slipped into your locked dye-house at 2:14 AM?
I’m back from Milan and heading to the dye-house now. Meet me by the back vent—I think the intruder dropped something.

nodes.headline: The 2:14 AM Intruder
nodes.teaser_text: Inside the silent dye-house sits a single electronic keycard—and its magnetic strip leads straight to the mastermind.

nodes.text: 8:40 PM · Lumière Dye-House. Under sterile blue inspection lamps, Marco lifts a matte-black access card from beneath the silk vats.

nodes.caption: Recovered VIP Master Keycard—stamped with the private suite code of Velvet Noir’s Paris hotel.

nodes.text: Wait a second—that’s a dual-encoded keycard! It unlocks Suite 1808 at the Royal Palace Hotel AND our old Lumière executive vault!
Only three people ever held the old vault cipher: my mother, our retired chief auditor, and the board proxy who fired my mother’s artisans.
Please stop digging into Suite 1808—if he finds out I lost his backup card he’ll leak my fake charity tax files!

nodes.prompt: Scarlett’s unsent panic proves she’s being blackmailed by Suite 1808:

options.label: Check the vent for a second clue
options.player_reply_text: Marco, shine your UV light inside the air vent—if someone squeezed through in a hurry, they snagged something.

options.label: Trace Suite 1808’s credit card billing
options.player_reply_text: Celine, have our legal investigator pull the corporate guarantor for Suite 1808 immediately.

nodes.text: Whoa! Something gold just clinked onto the concrete—it’s a heavy antique signet ring!
Got it! Suite 1808 is billed to an offshore shell owned by the exact proxy who pushed your mother off the board ten years ago!
You pick up the glinting gold band Marco found—and your breath catches as you recognize the engraving on its inner rim.
No way... This isn’t just any syndicate ring. That’s my mother’s missing founder signet—the one stolen the night she collapsed!

nodes.headline: Mid-Season Twist · The Stolen Signet
nodes.teaser_text: Ten years of secrets collide: the man behind Velvet Noir didn’t just steal your sketches—he stole your mother’s throne.

nodes.text: 9:15 PM · Lumière Private Archive. Under a jeweler’s loupe, the inner crest of the recovered ring tells a devastating ten-year story.

nodes.caption: Your late mother’s stolen gold founder signet—bearing the exact micro-notch stamped onto the forged Milan trademark wax seal.

nodes.text: Look at the notch on the gold band! He used your mother’s STOLEN signet ring to press the wax seal on the fake trademark transfer!
Fine! I’ll talk! He promised to erase my tax scandal if I ruined your runway and sprayed that decoy gown—I didn’t know he stole your mother’s ring!
Bad news, boss! Velvet Noir just petitioned the Fashion Council for an emergency trademark auction at 10 AM tomorrow!

nodes.prompt: You have 12 hours before the syndicate tries to auction your mother’s name:

options.label: Lock Scarlett’s confession on video
options.player_reply_text: Scarlett, come to our office tonight and sign a sworn statement before economic police—or sink with him.

options.label: Order forensic wax-notch comparison
options.player_reply_text: Send the ring to the forensic lab tonight—prove the notch didn’t exist until AFTER my mother’s ring was stolen!

nodes.text: I’m on my way! I’ll hand over every encrypted text he sent me from Suite 1808!
Brilliant! Your mother’s last wax seal from the Paris archive had ZERO notch—that proves the Milan deed was stamped years later!
Just as the pieces lock into place, Celine’s phone lights up with an emergency customs priority call.
Brace yourself—the syndicate just bribed a customs clerk to release the counterfeit Milan containers at midnight!

nodes.headline: Race Against Midnight
nodes.teaser_text: If those counterfeit gowns hit global boutiques tonight, Maison Lumière’s reputation will be shattered before the hearing.

nodes.text: 11:35 PM · Paris Port Highway. Rain hammers the windshield as your car speeds toward the customs bonded depot—and Celine calls.
The port inspector says he can’t hold Container 44 without your mother’s ORIGINAL wax-sealed atelier ledger—the digital scan isn’t enough!

nodes.transcript: [panting in the rain] "Pick up! Customs will release the counterfeit shipment in twenty minutes unless we bring the original wax-sealed ledger!"

nodes.text: Wait... my mother never kept her master ledger in the office safe. She hid it inside the lining of her very first couture mannequin!
I’m still inside the old Lumière archive room! Tell me which mannequin and I’ll unstitch the hem right now!

nodes.prompt: Only fifteen minutes left before the port gates open:

options.label: Guide Marco to the 1998 gold-thread bust
options.player_reply_text: Look for the 1998 emerald silk bust by the north skylight—unstitch the gold lotus hem!

options.label: Alert economic police to intercept dock
options.player_reply_text: Celine, send our forensic ring report straight to the economic police duty chief—ask them to block Gate 4 while Marco rides over!

nodes.text: FOUND IT! A waterproof silk pouch with your mother’s intact red wax seal—no notch anywhere! Jumping on my motorbike now!
Blue sirens just pulled across Gate 4! Not a single Velvet Noir truck is leaving this port tonight!
Headlights cut through the pouring rain as Marco skids up to the customs booth, thrusting the red-sealed ledger into your hands.
Open the velvet cover, inspector. Every original sketch, every gold-thread formula, and my mother’s REAL unbroken seal are right here.

nodes.headline: The Hidden Hem
nodes.teaser_text: Inside the ledger’s back pocket lies something even deadlier than a trademark—a handwritten list of who sabotaged your mother ten years ago.

nodes.text: 12:20 AM · Customs Inspection Room. Container 44 is officially impounded—and you unfold the yellowed letter tucked inside your mother’s ledger.
Listen to what my mother wrote: "If my signet ring ever disappears, look to Victor—the board proxy who tried to sell Lumière to Velvet Noir."
Everything connects! Ten years ago he couldn’t force your mother to sell, so he stole her ring, waited for the right moment, and built Velvet Noir in the shadows!
Wait—Victor just texted me that Container 44 was seized! He’s furious and heading to the airport!
He thinks he can still win tomorrow’s Fashion Council hearing by remote proxy—unless we blow up his chemical-dye lie before sunrise!

nodes.prompt: How do you lock down the evidence before the 10 AM tribunal?

options.label: Deliver the decoy dress to Swiss lab
options.player_reply_text: Send the swabbed decoy dress and Scarlett’s backstage spray bottle to the lab for an overnight rush verdict.

options.label: Flag Victor’s passport with border police
options.player_reply_text: Hand my mother’s letter and the stolen signet report to economic police—request an immediate travel freeze!

nodes.text: Lab director confirmed—the certified chemical fingerprint report will land in our inbox at 8 AM sharp!
Travel freeze approved! Economic police just locked his private jet on the tarmac!
Dawn begins to tint the Paris skyline pale gold. Act 3 opens—and this time, the hunters become the hunted.
Get some rest, team. At 10 AM, we end Velvet Noir forever.

nodes.headline: Act 3 · The Final Reckoning
nodes.teaser_text: The overnight lab verdict is in—and it shatters the toxic-silk hoax down to the exact fingerprint on the spray nozzle.

nodes.text: 8:05 AM · Maison Lumière Press Hall. Bright morning sun floods the marble atrium as the Swiss Textile Institute’s sealed report arrives.
100% vindication! The lab proved the rash chemical was surface-sprayed from an aerosol can—NOT woven into Lumière silk!
Even better—the chemical batch code matches an industrial solvent bought on Velvet Noir’s corporate card three days ago!
Publish the full Swiss report to every fashion magazine in Paris, Milan, and Tokyo. Let the buyers see who really tried to poison them.
{{player_name}}, please! Five luxury brands just dropped my contracts in ten minutes—my whole career is burning!

nodes.prompt: Every major fashion outlet is begging for your live reaction:

options.label: Thank the 20 seamstresses first on air
options.player_reply_text: Before we talk about lawsuits, I want the world to applaud the twenty artisans whose pure craftsmanship never faltered.

options.label: Challenge Velvet Noir live to show up
options.player_reply_text: Tell Velvet Noir’s shadow owner: bring your forged deed to the 10 AM Council hearing—I’m bringing my mother’s real ledger.

nodes.text: Pre-orders just tripled! Customers are calling Lumière the most honest couture house in Europe!
The hashtag #MaisonLumiereTruth just hit #1 worldwide! Velvet Noir’s PR account just went private!
Across town, cornered by investigators and bankrupt sponsors, Scarlett makes one last desperate move.
Don’t hang up on me—I have a recording of the broker wiring 5 million to bribe the trademark clerk. Meet me in ten minutes!

nodes.headline: Scarlett’s Bargain
nodes.teaser_text: Your bitterest rival is ready to flip on the mastermind—for one price.

nodes.text: 8:45 AM · Courthouse Coffee Annex. Stripped of her entourage and designer shades, Scarlett slides a trembling thumb drive across the table.
I’ll testify in open hearing against Victor and Velvet Noir. Just... don’t press the civil damages that will take my family’s house.

nodes.transcript: [recorded speakerphone, cold male voice] "The trademark clerk is paid. Once Lumière folds tomorrow, nobody will remember that seamstress’s mother."

nodes.text: That voice is unmistakable—Victor, the former Lumière board proxy! With this audio, economic police can arrest him right inside the Council hall!
You tore my gown, lied on live TV, and tried to poison our clients, Scarlett. You still answer to the law—no secret favors.

nodes.prompt: Scarlett pleads with tear-streaked eyes:

options.label: Accept her testimony, let court decide
options.player_reply_text: Hand the drive to investigators. Full cooperation will speak for itself with the judge—I won’t touch your parents’ home.

options.label: Demand a live public apology to artisans
options.player_reply_text: Tell the truth on your own livestream right now—apologize to every seamstress you humiliated, then hand the drive to police.

nodes.text: Thank you... I’m sorry I ever called you just a seamstress. You have more honor than all of us combined.
Two million viewers just watched Scarlett confess live! She named Velvet Noir’s mastermind before the stream even ended!
Suddenly, Scarlett’s phone starts vibrating violently on the table—the caller ID reads "PRIVATE — SUITE 1808."
It’s him! He knows I’m with you! Don’t answer—he’s capable of anything!

nodes.headline: The Mastermind Calls
nodes.teaser_text: One hour before the Fashion Council tribunal, the shadow kingpin dials in with one final, chilling threat.

nodes.text: 9:02 AM · Outside the Fashion Council Hall. You pick up Scarlett’s ringing phone on speaker while Celine quietly hits record.
[icy male voice on Scarlett’s line] "Drop the injunction in ten minutes, little seamstress, or your Milan warehouse goes up in smoke!"

nodes.transcript: [furious male voicemail] "Ignoring me won’t save you! Drop the Council filing now or watch your mother’s silk burn in Milan!"

nodes.text: Too late, Victor. You just confessed to arson threats on a police-monitored line—and economic police already cleared our Milan warehouse an hour ago.
He hung up! And the cell tower pinged him right inside the Council Hall’s VIP waiting lounge—he actually dared to show up in person!

nodes.prompt: The double oak doors of the International Fashion Council swing open:

options.label: Walk in wearing your mother’s gold brooch
options.player_reply_text: Let him see me walk in wearing my mother’s emerald silk and gold needle brooch. Tonight her name returns home.

options.label: Signal police to seal the hall exits
options.player_reply_text: Celine, tell the investigators to stand quietly outside all four exits until the Council Chair finishes reading the verdict.

nodes.text: Every single fashion editor stood up as you walked down the aisle! Victor’s jaw literally dropped!
All four exits sealed! The moment the gavel falls, Victor has nowhere left to run!
Inside the hushed tribunal chamber, Velvet Noir’s legal team rises smoothly—smirking as they present their forged Milan deed.
Thank you for displaying that forgery on the big screen, counselors. Now let me show the Council what a real wax seal looks like.

nodes.headline: The Wax-Sealed Showdown
nodes.teaser_text: One laser scan of your mother’s stolen ring is about to detonate a ten-year conspiracy in front of the entire fashion world.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · International Fashion Council Chamber. Three hundred press cameras zoom in as you place the velvet ledger beside the stolen signet ring.
Exhibit A: my mother’s unbroken red wax seal from 1998. Exhibit B: the laser scan proving Velvet Noir’s "deed" was stamped with a ring stolen AFTER her death.
And Exhibit C: Marco’s Milan vault footage plus Scarlett’s sworn audio of Victor admitting he bribed the trademark clerk!
Look at Victor’s face! He’s sweating through his bespoke suit and trying to slip out the side door!
I’m stepping up to the witness mic now, {{player_name}}. Every word I say will bury him for good.

nodes.prompt: The Council Chair asks for your final statement before the vote:

options.label: Dedicate the verdict to every artisan
options.player_reply_text: Couture isn’t built by shell companies or forged paper—it is stitched by honest hands. Restore Maison Lumière to its makers.

options.label: Demand full restitution of Milan flagship
options.player_reply_text: Not only do we reclaim our crest—we demand Velvet Noir’s Milan flagship be handed over to compensate our damaged artisans!

nodes.text: Unanimous 12-0 vote! The Council didn’t even need five minutes to deliberate!
Granted in full! Velvet Noir’s entire European retail network is officially seized to pay Lumière’s damages!
BANG! The Council Chair’s gavel echoes across the marble hall—and the heavy oak doors burst open to flashing badges.
It’s over! Economic police just cuffed Victor right beside the Velvet Noir banner!

nodes.headline: Velvet Noir Collapses
nodes.teaser_text: Watch the rival empire crumble to dust on live television—before Maison Lumière’s golden new dawn begins.

nodes.text: 2:00 PM · Grand Boulevard Plaza. Sunlight blazes off TV broadcast vans as Velvet Noir’s black-and-silver sign is hoisted down by cranes.
Breaking news: Velvet Noir’s board just filed for total liquidation, and Victor faces twenty years for trademark forgery, theft, and arson conspiracy!
And Scarlett just received a suspended sentence with 500 hours of community service—she’s leaving the industry for good.
One last text before I delete this number, {{player_name}}. Keep stitching truth into gold. You beat me fair and square.
Goodbye, Scarlett. Now let’s raise the real Maison Lumière crest over both Paris and Milan.

nodes.prompt: Your twenty loyal seamstresses await your announcement for tomorrow’s reopening:

options.label: Give every seamstress profit-sharing equity
options.player_reply_text: Every artisan who stayed through that sleepless night becomes a founding equity partner of Maison Lumière.

options.label: Open the Milan flagship as a free guild
options.player_reply_text: Turn Velvet Noir’s seized Milan palace into the Lumière Artisan Academy—free tuition for young tailors from working families.

nodes.text: Half the atelier is in tears of joy! You just wrote a new chapter in fashion history, {{player_name}}.
Standing ovation from the entire press corps! Fashion magazines are already calling you the Empress of Modern Couture!
Back in your quiet atelier office, you polish your mother’s recovered gold signet—and notice a tiny hinged clasp inside her silver master thimble.
Wait... there’s a folded silk ribbon tucked inside Mom’s thimble. She left one last message for the day I reclaimed our house.

nodes.headline: The Final Thread
nodes.teaser_text: Tomorrow morning, Maison Lumière opens its golden doors to the world—and your mother’s final secret completes the crown.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Grand Reopening of Maison Lumière. Golden morning sunlight pours across the white marble courtyard as global buyers and artisans gather.
All twenty emerald-and-gold gowns are displayed under the glass dome, and our Paris-Milan-Tokyo flagship network is officially live!
From being yelled at backstage to cutting the gold ribbon as Chairwoman—not a single person here will ever underestimate a seamstress again!
Before I cut the ribbon, let me read the silk note hidden in my mother’s silver thimble: "True luxury is never inherited—it is earned stitch by stitch."
And look at the back of the ribbon—your mother secretly registered the Global Artisan Guild endowment in YOUR name twenty years ago!

nodes.prompt: Golden scissors rest in your palm as cameras flash across the courtyard:

options.label: Cut the ribbon with your seamstresses
options.player_reply_text: Step up beside me, ladies! We stitched this empire together—we open it together!

options.label: Unveil the golden statue of your mother
options.player_reply_text: Pull the emerald velvet curtain—today Maison Lumière rises in eternal honor of the woman who taught me every stitch.

nodes.text: Thunderous applause! That front-page photo of twenty-one hands on the gold ribbon will be iconic forever!
Pure magic! Even the toughest fashion critics are wiping away tears as golden confetti drifts down!
Sunlight catches your mother’s gold signet on your finger as the doors of Maison Lumière swing wide to a cheering world.
Welcome to the House of Gold—stitched by hand, built to reign forever.

nodes.headline: Grand Finale · Empress Of Couture
nodes.teaser_text: The ten-year conspiracy is crushed, your mother’s stolen signet and guild are restored, and the humble seamstress now rules the global house of gold.
